subject: Dedicated capacity sizing deep-dive — next steps for FinArc
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Colby <sam.colby@finarc.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — FinArc / Redwood next steps

Hi Sam — really appreciated the time today. Quick recap and clear next step so we can move to a sizing call with our infra team.

Recap (from our call)
- Primary goal: embed low-latency fraud scoring in checkout and auth flows. Target p50 latency <= 100ms end-to-end for the model inference portion.
- Expected steady throughput: ~50 req/s per region, peak bursts ~350–450 req/s for short windows (1–3 min).
- Model: currently evaluating a distilled 7B variant (we think ~13GB weights) with KV cache, single-turn scoring.
- Compliance: SOC 2 required, US data residency, no PII persisted outside request logs.

Ask / next step
- We should schedule a dedicated capacity sizing deep-dive (technical) with your infra/ML-ops folks and our serving/runtime team (Vivek + Tessa). The goal: align on throughput, tail latency SLOs, load shaping, and an initial GPU pool recommendation.
- Pre-read: I attached a short capacity intake template — if you can fill the highlighted tabs (QPS, request size, concurrency pattern, expected sequence length, and any burst patterns) before the call it will make the session much more productive.

Suggested windows (PT):
- Tue Jun 8, 10:00–11:00am PT
- Wed Jun 9, 1:00–2:00pm PT
(If those don't work, drop 2–3 times that fit and we'll follow.)

Proposed agenda (30–45m)
- 5m: intros + success criteria
- 15m: workload walk-through (you + Priya)
- 15m: runtime sizing recommendations (Vivek)
- 5–10m: next steps / mutual action plan

Attachments: capacity_intake_template.xlsx (please fill key fields)

If the high-level targets above look off, call it out now and we can adjust. Happy to take the calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

Thanks again,

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

---
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for modern ML apps

From: Sam Colby <sam.colby@finarc.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya.ramesh@finarc.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 17:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — FinArc / Redwood next steps

Thanks Stephanie — good recap and yes that aligns with what we discussed. Priya (cc) will join from product. A couple quick clarifications before we book:
- The model size estimate is approximate — we currently run an internal smaller variant and are evaluating the 7B distilled model as part of the POC.
- For bursts, the 350–450 rps are expected during peak load testing and occasional campaign bursts. We anticipate those for ~2–5 minutes at a time.

Of the proposed windows the Wed Jun 9, 1:00–2:00pm PT works best for our team. If possible can you include an agenda item about fallback/failover behavior — we want to understand graceful degradation (e.g., fallback to smaller model or degraded features) and how Redwood handles that with Dedicated pools.

I'll attach a small CSV with our coarse request-size distribution — Sam_note_qps.csv (sending from the product mailbox).

Appreciate it,
Sam

Meeting details / pre-reads:
- Please review and, if possible, populate the "Load profile" and "Burst characteristics" tabs in capacity_intake_template.xlsx ahead of the meeting.
- Agenda updated to include a 10-minute block on graceful degradation and model fallback strategies (requested).
- Expected attendees from our side: Stephanie (AE), Tessa (Solutions Eng), Vivek (Serving Runtime).

Mutual action plan (short):
1) FinArc: fill capacity intake template + share any recent load test traces (if available) — due Mon Jun 14.
2) Redwood: produce a draft dedicated pool recommendation (GPU SKU, initial pool size, expected p50/p95 for configured SLO) within 3 business days after the call.
3) Both: schedule pilot reservation once sizing is validated (timeline TBD).

Attachments included: SOW_v1.pdf (informal draft for budgeting), capacity_intake_template.xlsx

If anything else should be on the agenda, flag now and we will add. Looking forward to the call.

Best,

Subject: RE: Discovery call — Confirmed: Wed Jun 9 1:00pm PT — FinArc dedicated sizing deep-dive

Stephanie / Tessa — quick internal note prior to the call:
- Based on the quick numbers (50 steady / 400 burst, 7B-ish model) I'm expecting an initial recommendation in the ballpark of 2–4 A100-class GPUs (shared pool with autoscale for bursts) if they keep the current distilled variant; could be lower with int8/quantized path. Exact depends on sequence length and KV cache reuse — ask them to include median/95th token lengths in the template.
- If they can share a couple of recent tail-latency traces (p50/p95/p99) and a sample of request size distribution (Sam indicated he would attach a CSV) that will let me refine the pool sizing prior to the call.
- I'll prepare two scenario slides: conservative (no quantization) and optimized (quantized + caching).

I'll sync with Tessa on a few runtime questions to surface during the meeting.

— Vivek
Staff Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
